GeneDef.label: Momo
GeneDef.description: This woman has inherited the "Inma" of the current Mamono Lord.

customEffectDescriptions.li: This woman has inherited the "Inma" of the current Mamono Lord.
Melee strikes inflict tease damage on pawns without this gene, eroding their willpower.
Her fertility never fades with age.
The ailments of old age never touch her; ones she already has silently melt away.

GeneDef.label: flight
GeneDef.description: This woman's body bears powerful wings. She can soar across the battlefield at will, and on the world map she flies - strong enough to carry a passenger on her back.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Grants the "Fly" ability: leap through the air to a distant location, soaring over obstacles.
In a caravan she flies instead of walking, and can airlift one passenger on her back: each flyer counts as two caravan members moving at 350% speed.

GeneDef.label: momo venom
GeneDef.description: This momo's body produces a slowing venom that her strikes pass into her victims. As it builds, limbs grow heavy until the victim can no longer stand - helpless, unharmed, and fully conscious. The venom is never lethal and wears off completely within hours.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Melee strikes inject venom into any living victim - humans, animals and other momos alike.
The venom slows the victim as it builds (about 20 strikes to fully pin), then wears off completely within 4 hours.
Non-lethal: a fully envenomed victim simply collapses, conscious and alive.

GeneDef.label: fiery momo
GeneDef.description: These momo are unaffected by heat, fire or lava, being infused with an excess of the Fire Element. Typically these momo can control the Fire Element in other ways too.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Immune to fire, heat and lava: she cannot be set aflame, takes no flame damage, and no heat can discomfort her.
A man bonded to her shares a lesser ward: +40C max comfortable temperature, 15% less flammable, 15% less flame damage.

GeneDef.label: momo claws
GeneDef.description: These sharp claws, meant for vicious killing during the time of the last Mamono Lord, now serve a different, more lustful purpose. Momo claws cut the skin, causing a great heat to radiate into the victim's body, inflaming their lusts. These claws however do interfere with the dexterity of the momo.
